Bluetooth Beanie Headphones Hat Unique Tech Gifts Stock…

A beanie with hidden Bluetooth headphones built right in. The speakers sit flat against your ears under the fabric, so it looks like a normal winter hat but plays music, podcasts, or calls through integrated drivers. Battery lasts about 6 hours on a charge, and the controls are hidden in the brim — volume, skip, answer calls. Perfect for anyone who walks or commutes in cold weather and doesn't want to choose between warm ears and music. The sound quality won't beat dedicated headphones, but for the convenience factor (one item instead of hat + headphones), it's a surprisingly solid trade-off. Machine washable too.
